protocol.audit_status: pre-runtime source/projection audit; no native result asserted

input_contract.sequence: Each of all 67 source-comparison experiences exactly once; record deterministic order; one fresh engine and shared 対象系境界
input_contract.内容: Exact full original comparison leaf values and exact pinned-code source line-spans only, represented as opaque strings grouped into externally supplied seven semantic fields; preserve span text and array order; omit absent fields, never insert 未記録.
input_contract.対象: JSON string containing complete normalized record, all raw comparison UTF-8 source, exact commit/blob/path, quotation/pointer/span evidence, supplementary code provenance and exact text, separately typed fresh baseline runtime admission provenance, origin annotations and projection/exclusion map.
input_contract.文脈: empty; intake context is not persisted by native memory

projection.dedup: Deduplicate reuse of the same original source leaf pointer or exact (source_path,start_line,end_line) code range within one record only. Equal values at genuinely distinct original pointers/ranges are source-native equality and remain allowed, with provenance annotations. Do not duplicate one evidence source across normalized fields.
projection.missing: Keep required eight-field external experience schema and all evidence in archive; inferential fields absent after exclusion remain omitted.

exclude_exact.source: 検証/テンプレート充填比較.json

projection.retain: Keep actual rule grammar, guards and domain restrictions, including intrinsic numeric constraints and source-described limitations. Do not filter all numbers or all words such as 確認.
projection.scope: Complete archive is transported and retained; inferential 内容 is a declared restricted source-text and pinned-code-text projection. All code remains opaque scalar text to native intake; no source execution/parser is added. This trial does not test semantic parsing of archived evidence hidden from native inference.

code_supplement.allowed: Exact complete source line ranges verified against pinned commit; prefer whole logical blocks so qualifications are preserved.
not_content: external shared skeleton or concept vocabulary
code_supplement.interpretation: Code names, operations and classification are supplied observations, not newly derived concepts. Exact code-text equality is a scalar relation, not program isomorphism.
code_supplement.runtime_provenance: Fresh baseline admission observations remain separately typed, dated, linked to their own baseline/freeze and metadata-only. They must not be represented as observations present in original comparison JSON.

freeze.before_native_call: Write protocol and projection manifest to local deliverable staging; compute SHA256 of protocol, ordered exact payloads and 12 pinned core files; record hashes in report. Any projection change requires a new version before native run, never tune to observed answers.

capture.outputs: Raw dataclass 外部出力 for every completed call, retaining native wording and counts
capture.ledgers: Read-only 台帳.全取得 or JSON相当 snapshots and final 保存する file
capture.retention: Compare each stored 原入力 to exact supplied 内容, and json.loads(経験記録.対象) to the complete archive; independently match all 67 source byte lengths/blob hashes. Reload through HDS学習系統.読み込む and repeat equality checks. Also verify supplemental code ranges against pinned source bytes/blob and preserve fresh runtime provenance as a separate source class.
capture.trace_limits: Outward output omits full mapping/support tables; 原理台帳 includes adopted mappings. Native 推論記録台帳 omits full tables for some non-adopted candidates; do not monkeypatch or rerun private inference to fill this gap.
capture.query_note: 照会 does not append observations or update adoption state, but does increment identifier counters; do not claim bit-for-bit entire-engine nonmutation from its docstring.

levels.criterion: The intended payload is attempted through unchanged public input path and rejected or cannot enter as an observation.
Native run retains every supplied experience and complete source/provenance archive; exact in-memory and native save/reload checks pass.
levels.does_not_imply: Opaque text storage is not semantic recognition.

levels.criterion: Native traces derive an identifiable cross-experience equality or common deterministic scalar correspondence from independently sourced supplied values. Cite actual condition/result paths, values, distinct source records, native relation type and support refs.
qualifiers: Native exact scalar equality/commonality may count with explicitly limited meaning; no NLP prerequisite is imposed.
External normalization category labels are supplied, not discovered.
A table assigning unique prose inputs to unrelated unique prose outputs is opaque lookup, not demonstrated common rule elements.
Input-copied quote equality, missing sentinels, IDs and score correlations do not count.
Report native mapping existence even when it fails the requested commonality criterion.

levels.criterion: A native output derives a named inclusion/isomorphism/overlap/contradiction relation between identifiable experienced rules, linked to their evidence. Report each subtype actually established; do not assert unobserved subtypes.
levels.limits: Native learned-scalar-rule condition-path subset checks, prediction conflict, quarantine, or input prose using a relation name are not automatically semantic inclusion/isomorphism of experienced ARC rule programs.

levels.criterion: Native execution generates a higher-order rule candidate from earlier observed rule relations, with a derivation trace and representable conditions; it is not an externally supplied skeleton or renamed scalar lookup.
Native execution evaluates that generated higher-order candidate against identifiable supporting and counterexample experiences, preserving the actual outcomes and scope.
The same higher-order candidate is natively admitted, retained and actually used in a later authorized native query; show candidate-to-principle-to-use trace.
Native trace shows that derived rule integrating, specializing or replacing an older rule with parent/child or version lineage and later use; unrelated scalar-state updates are reported separately.

protocol.stop_rule: Assess consecutive levels and stop semantic advancement at the first unsupported criterion. Atomic 処理する may naturally emit later-stage native events; preserve them without using them to bypass an earlier failed criterion. No feature additions, private inference hooks, source rewrites or answer seeding.
protocol.resource_rule: Preflight native intake path count and record configured runner budgets before execution. Default max2 combination bound is p*((p-1)+(p-1)*(p-2)/2) per step. Timeout/resource failure is incomplete execution, never absence of capability. Do not change learner thresholds or representational atoms for speed.
protocol.independence: No ARC solver/adapter/fitter/scorer/runner modifications. Existing baseline/current grid regression belongs to its separate runner evidence and cannot establish semantic re-observation levels.
protocol.revision_reason: Before any native trial: allow parent-requested exact pinned-code source ranges to supplement missing descriptive semantics; no code execution or semantic-parser changes.
